About us

Horizon Elevator Co., Ltd.

Horizon Elevators is the international brand of Chongqing Haike Elevator Co., Ltd., an elevator manufacturing company headquartered in the Liangjiang New Area of Chongqing, China, one of the country's major machinery and electronics industrial bases.

Founded in December 2020, Horizon integrates R&D, manufacturing, quality inspection, export and after-sales support. Our production covers home lifts, platform lifts, sightseeing (panoramic) lifts, passenger elevators, freight elevators and special vertical-transport equipment.

Operating under a dual-centre model between China and Australia, we prioritise overseas markets (Australia, New Zealand, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, Africa and Russia) while maintaining a domestic presence across China.

The Horizon Range

Every car, shaft frame, door and operating panel below is designed and produced in our Chongqing facility, with full customisation of colours, glass, lighting and finishes.

HX Series home and platform lifts

Steel-belt traction lifts with aluminium frames and glass shafts for tight stairwells and open atriums. All HX models run 2 to 6 floors with a light curtain and one-touch emergency call.

Safety and comfort as standard

  • Automatic rescue device on power loss
  • Light curtain at the doorway
  • One-touch emergency call
  • Voice floor selection
  • Overload protection
  • Child safety lock
  • Silent contactors
  • Fault logging and fault codes
  • Automatic one-touch rescue
  • Real-time circuit monitoring

Finishes

Four standard frame colours, with Oriental Red and Orange available as custom colours. Choose clear, ultra-clear, porcelain-white or blue star grey glass, and four ambient lighting tones.

Car controls: 10.1-inch touchscreen as standard, 13.3-inch touchscreens optional.

H8U Series residential elevators

Aluminium-frame home elevators in three configurations, with observation-glass cars and a wide library of car wall, ceiling and floor finishes in Concise, Designer, Chinese Style and Luxury collections.

H8U-Pad

Standard cabins in off-white, champagne beige and titanium grey, with manual sliding doors and a 10.1-inch touchscreen.

H8U-Plus

Side-placed counterweight or rear placement, with automatic centre-opening doors as standard.

H8U-Pro

Steel-panel cabins and landing doors for villas and low-rise buildings, from brushed stainless steel to coloured designer panels, wood-lined luxury cars and etched Chinese-style interiors.
